title: TaskReport v1
description: The runner's report on one task attempt. status is a state claim, not a truth claim — acceptance is decided by control gates elsewhere. Carries the five-component usage split as a protocol condition. Forward-compatible envelope; the nested usage object is deliberately closed.

status.description: Terminal status of the attempt. Open string; common values below.

summary_business.description: Result stated in business language (for the CTO / chat surface).

controls.description: Control-gate outcomes keyed by control name (lint/types/tests/...). Each value carries a pass/fail status and an optional log tail. Forward-compatible.

questions.description: Business-language questions raised when status is blocked.

failure_type.description: Failure taxonomy label when the attempt failed. Open string; the confirmed slice taxonomy is shown as examples, values are host policy.

iterations.description: Number of coder iterations spent on the attempt.

usage.description: Five-component token split for the attempt (aggregate across calls). Required: usage accounting is a protocol condition even for blocked/failed reports (report zeros, never omit the split).
